{{Top|leg}}
'''Skalds''' were servants sent out to find valuable mining, farming, or building sites for their masters. They were usually in debt to their masters, and were rarely set free.

[[Pupaku]] the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] was a Skald.
